title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: SAP FICO Consultant – ICT / Trading Partner / Healthcare
description:
We are looking for a Senior SAP FICO & SD Consultant to support and enhance a highly customized Trading Partner (TP) / Intercompany Trading (ICT) solution, with strong exposure to Healthcare financial processes (HCO/HCP).

This is a great opportunity to work in a complex, bespoke SAP environment, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, BAU teams, and FUSION teams, and playing a key role in compliance, audits, and continuous improvements.

What You’ll Do

Trading Partner / Intercompany (Bespoke Solution)

  • Support and enhance a non‑standard, highly customized Trading Partner solution
  • Understand and manage end‑to‑end bespoke business processes
  • Translate complex intercompany and TP requirements into SAP functional solutions
  • Support audit, compliance, testing, and documentation activities
  • Collaborate with FUSION teams on enhancements and regulatory changes


SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling)

  • Configure and support:
  • FI: GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting
  • CO: Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, CO‑PA
  • Strong hands‑on experience with:
  • Trading Partner accounting
  • Intercompany eliminations & tax
  • Product Costing (SAP ECC) in ICT environments
  • Support month‑end and year‑end closing
  • Work with healthcare-specific financial processes (HCO/HCP)
  • Experience with SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA (IS‑H is a plus)

SAP SD

  • Support SD processes integrated with Trading Partner solutions:
  • Order‑to‑Cash
  • Pricing
  • Billing
  • Output Management
  • Work with interfaces, IDocs, and custom logic
  • Ensure strong FI‑SD integration

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions with BAU teams
  • Create and maintain BRD, FSD, configuration documents, and test scripts
  • Support UAT, regression testing, and solution validation
  • Work closely with ABAP teams on developments and fixes

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience as an SAP FICO Consultant in complex, customized environments
  • Solid exposure to SAP SD, especially in intercompany scenarios
  • Deep knowledge of Trading Partner / Intercompany (ICT) accounting
  • Experience supporting audits and regulated environments
  • Healthcare domain knowledge (HCO/HCP) is highly valued
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in GSK‑bespoke or similar complex ICT environments
  • SAP IS‑H knowledge
  • S/4HANA transformation or migration experience
  • Experience in global / multinational projects

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Where you Fit In:


As a Senior QA Engineer , you are a key technical leader within Quality Engineering. You own quality across complex, mission-critical systems and play an active role in shaping automation standards, testing strategy, and long-term reliability.


You go beyond execution — influencing decisions and ensuring quality is embedded into the engineering lifecycle.


You are a highly technical, systems-oriented QA professional with strong automation expertise.

You understand how systems interact across the stack and think proactively about risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You don’t just validate features — you anticipate failure points, analyze trade-offs, and design quality solutions accordingly.

You are confident leading discussions, mentoring others, and raising the bar for engineering excellence.


The impact you will have:


  • Troubleshoot critical issues across environments and support root cause analysis
  • Reduce flakiness and improve test stability and execution reliability
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision
  • Identify strategic quality risks and advocate for prioritization
  • Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards
  • Continuously improving the Automation Framework and overall automation coverage
  • Lead testing strategy for complex, cross-team systems.


What we’re looking for:


Technical

  • Strong experience in automation testing
  • Advanced English
  • Understanding of system architecture and cross-team dependencies
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack
  • Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage
  • Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability.


Execution

  • Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team initiatives
  • Breaks down large challenges into structured execution plans
  • Owns quality from design through production
  • Aligns technical decisions with broader company goals.


Collaboration & Influence

  • Clearly communicates risks, trade-offs, and system impact
  • Act as a mentor to teammates and contributes to team growth
  • Builds consensus and leads by example.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Home office

Segunda a Sexta das 08 às 17h.


Principais responsabilidades:

Gerenciar e sustentar ambientes de missão crítica em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP ).

Implementar e otimizar esteiras de CI/CD para automação de deploys.

Trabalhar com orquestração de containers utilizando Kubernetes (K8s) e Docker .

Desenvolver automações de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform ou Ansible .

Garantir a observabilidade dos sistemas (monitoramento, logs e alertas).

Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento para disseminar a cultura DevOps.


Requisitos:

Sólida experiência em administração de ambientes Cloud.

Domínio de ferramentas de IaC (Terraform será um diferencial).

Experiência prática com Kubernetes e ecossistema de containers.

Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions).

Vivência com sistemas operacionais Linux e scripting (Bash, Python ou Go).


Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security





**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Sr. Mainframe Developer (COBOL)
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Sr. Mainframe COBOL Developer to join an international project supporting a US client in the life insurance industry. This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to the maintenance, enhancement, and migration of critical mainframe-based insurance administration systems.



Main Challenges:


  • Maintain and enhance legacy mainframe systems written in Assembler and COBOL , working with VSAM file structures
  • Support and develop applications on the Ingenium platform (COBOL/DB2)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across multiple mainframe environments
  • Support ongoing data extraction and migration efforts toward a third-party administrator (TPA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and continuity
  • Provide knowledge transfer and documentation to preserve institutional knowledge


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience in mainframe development experience with COBOL (critical)
  • Hands-on experience with IBM Mainframe Assembler programming on z/OS
  • Proven background in life insurance or annuities systems (policy administration, claims, or billing)
  • Experience working with VSAM file structures on mainframe environments
  • Hands-on experience with DB2 on IBM mainframe
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in legacy/production environments
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English with US-based client teams


Preferred Background:


  • Familiarity with Ingenium or similar insurance administration platforms
  • Experience with data migration or system conversion projects
  • Exposure to CICS Transaction Gateway and Unix environments
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent


This role is especially relevant for professionals who have worked in life insurance mainframe environments, supported legacy system modernization, and are comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities in a direct, fast-paced team culture.

title: Data Migration Analyst - Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented professional with a strong foundation in Data Migration and

advanced expertise in SQL and PL/SQL. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between

complex financial data and actionable business insights by designing, developing, and

maintaining robust database solutions. You will be responsible for ensuring data integrity,

optimizing financial reporting processes, and automating workflows within multiple applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Technical assistance in writing scripts and workflows for data generation, cleansing, and

de-duplication

  • Analyze and massage legacy data for migration
  • Database Support: Troubleshoot and Support SQL, PL/SQL packages, procedures,

functions, and triggers to support financial applications.

  • Data Integrity: Implement rigorous data validation and reconciliation logic to ensure

\"\"single source of truth\"\" financial reporting.


Deliverables:

  • Enhanced Customer Data: Refined datasets optimized for Cloud accounts and

BAG primitives.

  • SQL Scripts: All custom queries and code used for the data migration/analysis.
  • Customer Health Reports: Documentation regarding account status and data

integrity.


Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or
  • Management Information Systems (MIS).
  • Technical Skills: * Expert-level SQL and Oracle PL/SQL.
  • Experience with relational database management systems (RDBMS).
  • Experience with Data Migration
  • Fluent English.


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: SAP SuccessFactors Consultant
description:
About the Company



K2 Partnering Solutions is a global leader in providing consultative solutions within enterprise applications, artificial intelligence, and cloud technologies. We specialize in delivering skilled human capital and consulting services to empower businesses in implementing and optimizing critical technology solutions. With an expansive network of over 1 million experts, K2 connects top talent with clients to foster success amidst an evolving tech landscape. Our comprehensive services include consulting, recruitment, professional training and certifications via K2 University, and innovative platform solutions for connecting talent and opportunities.




About the Role



SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding Consultant


Responsibilities



  • Map HR processes to SuccessFactors functionality (e.g., hiring, onboarding, payroll triggers).
  • Employee Central (EC): Foundation objects, workflows, business rules, position management.
  • Recruiting Management (RCM): Job requisitions, candidate pipeline, interview scheduling.
  • Payroll (SAP or 3rd party systems).
  • SAP ERP/S4HANA (using Boomi, CPI, or Point-to-Point).
  • Identity providers for SSO and provisioning.
  • Use tools like Integration Center, Middleware (Boomi/CPI), and API tools.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT (User Acceptance Testing).
  • Assist HR users in validating workflows, reports, and data migration results.
  • Document test cases and expected outcomes.
  • Collaborate with global HR, IT, and functional leads.
  • Provide input for project planning, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Participate in daily/weekly meetings, status reporting, and risk tracking.


Required Skills


3 - 5 years of experience with SAP SuccessFactors

Experience with Onboarding 1.0 & 2.0

Recruiting Marketing is a must

Based in Brazil or Colombia

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. Job Description:

• Design and deploy Endpoint Privilege Management platforms (e.g., BeyondTrust ) across Windows and macOS environments.

• Install and manage EPM agents, management consoles, and event collectors.

• Conduct Proof of Concept, pilot deployments, and enterprise rollout strategies.

• Create least-privilege policies, application control rules, and privilege elevation workflows.

• Document architecture, runbooks, SOPs, and operational procedures.

• Generate audit reports and dashboards for security and compliance teams.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.

  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.

  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.

  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

  • Requisitos Técnicos e de Negócio (Core ACM)

title: Localization Operations & Growth (Portuguese)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | Full-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Monitor local trends and market information in the local language region, synchronize with headquarters, and provide localized perspective analysis.
  • Participate in the development of the brand marketing and operational framework for the local language region, driving the implementation of brand communication content that aligns with local culture.
  • Write and optimize PR content for local vertical media to enhance the brand’s exposure and influence in the professional field.
  • Possess market launch and promotional experience, assist in formulating and executing localized promotion strategies, and optimize the effectiveness of campaigns.
  • Support the planning and execution of local offline events in the local language region, responsible for local logistics coordination and client liaison (meeting clients) to ensure efficient event and business execution.
  • Provide localized support to various functions at headquarters, including identifying hot topics for brand marketing, coordinating local channels for advertising, and sourcing scalable local websites for SEO.
  • Assist in streamlining localized operational workflows and contribute to the development of standardized procedures.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, PR, Marketing, or related fields.
  • Experience in localization operations, marketing, or PR; experience in offline event execution and logistics coordination is preferred.
  • Familiar with the culture, social platforms, and media ecosystem of the local language region; capable of PR content writing and market promotion optimization; understands local logistics and business coordination processes.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to efficiently connect headquarters, local media, partners, and clients.
  • Proactive thinking and execution ability, with strong delivery, business negotiation skills, and responsibility.
  • Knowledge of the Portuguese-speaking region’s Web3 ecosystem, with successful PR collaboration or market promotion cases in vertical media.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, or Chinese and Portuguese is essential.


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Banco de Talentos GFT - QA Automação
description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.


Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir com a evolução das práticas de qualidade e engenharia de testes;
  • Participar de code reviews e disseminar boas práticas de testes.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Analista Funcional Pleno Dynamics 365
description:
Especialistas em tecnologias e plataformas para gestão para negócios, somos reconhecidamente, uma das principais provedoras de soluções Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM no Brasil.

Com foco na inovação e comprometidos com a qualidade, nossos projetos já ajudaram muitas empresas a mudarem o futuro das pessoas.

Nossa cultura está baseada em entregar inovação e criatividade com alta performance trazendo para o time, profissionais que possuam espírito inovador, alma empreendedora e obsessão em evoluir.

Então, vamos realizar juntos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de perfil funcional para condução de levantamentos, mapeamento de processos, documentação funcional e interface com o cliente ao longo do projeto.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos funcionais junto ao cliente;
  • Mapear processos de negócio e traduzi‑los para o Dynamics 365;
  • Elaborar documentação funcional (requisitos, fluxos, histórias);
  • Apoiar o time técnico no entendimento das regras de negócio;
  • Participar de validações, testes e homologações com o cliente;
  • Atuar como ponto focal funcional no projeto.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência prévia atuando como analista funcional em Dynamics 365;
  • Conhecimento dos módulos de Sales e/ou Customer Service;
  • Vivência em projetos de CRM ou soluções corporativas;
  • Capacidade de modelagem de processos e regras de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com Dataverse e conceitos da Power Platform.


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Excelente comunicação com clientes e times internos;
  • Perfil analítico e organizado;
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões e workshops;
  • Senso de prioridade e foco em geração de valor para o cliente.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Cartão benefício Flash com vale refeição de R$30,00/dia;
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino para graduação e especializações;
  • Assistência médica e odontológica sem coparticipação;
  • Incentivo para educação (idiomas);
  • Aplicativos de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Parceria com o SESC;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto;
  • Treinamentos e Certificação;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e feedback 1:1


Na Bizapp apoiamos a igualdade de gênero, cor, idade, orientação sexual, crença e deficiência. Por isso, todos os candidatos são considerados igualmente em nossos processos.

title: Account Manager
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint.
  • Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution.
  • Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations.
  • Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template.
  • Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We’re supporting a client building a high-impact platform , and they’re looking for an Automation Engineer to take ownership of their testing capability.


This is a long-term contract (through to end of 2026) , ideal for someone looking for stability while working on a complex, real-world system.


What you’ll be doing

  • Designing and building automated test frameworks using TestComplete
  • Creating and maintaining smoke, regression, and integration test suites
  • Integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins)
  • Automating from existing manual test cases (JIRA/Rally) with full traceability
  • Driving quality improvements across the release lifecycle


What we’re looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience with TestComplete
  • Experience with JavaScript, Python, or VBScript for automation
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD (Jenkins)
  • Experience with API and system-level testing
  • Ability to work across Windows and Linux environments


Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare / clinical systems (HL7)
  • JSON validation, SMTP/WCTP protocols
  • Exposure to WebLogic, VMware, Apache


The details

  • Contract until December 2026
  • Rate: $20 per hour
  • Long-term, stable project environment

title: Administrador de sistema e banco de dados
description:
Administrador de Banco de Dados

Buscamos um Administrador de Banco de Dados qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve possuir sólida experiência em MongoDB e Redis, e conhecimentos em PostgreSQL serão considerados um diferencial. Esta é uma oportunidade incrível para um profissional que deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, contribuindo para a performance e segurança de nossos sistemas de dados.


Responsabilidades:

- Administrar e otimizar bancos de dados MongoDB e Redis, garantindo alta disponibilidade e desempenho.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento na modelagem de dados e na criação de consultas eficientes.

- Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de backup e recuperação de dados para assegurar a integridade das informações.

- Monitorar o desempenho dos bancos de dados, realizando tuning e ajustes conforme necessário.

- Garantir a segurança dos dados, implementando políticas de acesso e controle de usuários.

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e melhores práticas relacionadas à administração de bancos de dados.

- Resolver problemas de banco de dados de maneira proativa, minimizando o tempo de inatividade.


Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada em administração de banco de dados MongoDB e Redis.

- Conhecimento prático em PostgreSQL será um diferencial.

- Habilidade em otimização de desempenho e troubleshooting.

- Familiaridade com práticas de backup, recuperação de dados e segurança.

- Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e se comunicar efetivamente com diferentes áreas da empresa.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem e soluções de banco de dados como serviço (DBaaS).

- Conhecimento em outras tecnologias de banco de dados NoSQL e relacionais.

title: Performance Marketing  Specialist
description:
Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it. Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!


We are seeking a Performance Marketing Specialist to lead our paid user acquisition efforts across B2C and lead acquisition for B2B. In an increasingly complex SaaS environment, you will operate as a high-impact IC, owning all paid marketing channels.


This role’s responsibilities will include search engine marketing (SEM / PPC), social media marketing (SMM), budget management, lead generation, keyword research, measuring data and analytics, working cross functionally with Sales and Product Marketing, and more. A key focus will be leveraging AI and new tooling to drive efficiency and scale.

This role reports directly to the Senior Lead of Acquisition.


Responsibilities:

  • Direct strategy and execution of all paid acquisition across B2C and B2B
  • Work cross functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Brand & Content, and more
  • Set and manage monthly and quarterly budgets and goals for paid marketing
  • Own SEM, SMM, OTT, Reddit, and all other paid marketing channels
  • Implement and oversee marketing automation and advanced tooling to streamline workflows
  • A/B test new channels, ad types, messaging/targeting, and more
  • Be data-driven, keeping us honest to monthly and quarterly goals for paid growth


Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of paid marketing experience
  • 3 years of experience owning Paid Search (SEM)
  • 3 years of experience owning Paid Social (SMM)
  • Experience owning large marketing budgets (8 figures annually)
  • Strong experience in both B2C and B2B acquisition
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Confident in pushing back on \"bad ideas\" or low-impact requests through data-backed reasoning
  • Experience in SaaS is a plus


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in R$ (BRL).

This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s team based in Brazil and in the United States.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD) - Brazil
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.


We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Business Development Manager who will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships, and promoting our trading solutions across markets. This role requires strong knowledge of the online trading industry and the ability to convert opportunities into long-term business relationships.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, IBs, and affiliates
  • Identify client trading needs and propose suitable brokerage services, platforms, and solutions
  • Effectively communicate the company’s value proposition, trading conditions, platforms, and partnership programs
  • Research sales statistics and assess growth opportunities within target markets
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, partners, and clients within the CRM system
  • Coordinate with internal departments (Dealing, Compliance, Marketing, Support) to ensure high service standards and client satisfaction
  • Conduct presentations, webinars, and platform demonstrations to prospective clients and partners


Key Requirements


  • Proven experience in Business Development / Sales within a CFD / Forex Brokerage
  • Strong understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and brokerage operations
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage
  • Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities
  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, expos, and industry events


What We Offer


  • Competitive base salary & performance-based incentives and bonuses
  • Opportunity to influence regional partnership and client acquisition strategies
  • Career progression within a well-established Forex Brokerage environment
  • Exposure to global financial markets and advanced trading technologies
  • Flexible working arrangement


If you’re a results-driven business development professional with industry experience and a passion for building strong client and partner relationships, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.

title: Product / Marketing Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Product/Marketing Analyst to work on configuring and managing offers and partners within our PRM (Partner Relationship Management) system, ensuring the efficient execution of initiatives requested by the operator Vivo and coordinating activities with internal departments.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


· Configure offers and partners in the PRM system.


· Receive, analyze, and manage requests for new initiatives (new offers, changes, or the addition of new partners) from Vivo.


· Create status presentations and reports to track the initiatives.


· Coordinate with internal departments such as Development, Support, and QA as needed.


· Perform functional testing of offers prior to launch, ensuring quality and compliance.


· Support communication and alignment with internal and external stakeholders.


REQUIREMENTS:


· Experience in digital product management or product marketing.


· Knowledge of partner management platforms or CRM.


· Ability to create clear and objective presentations and reports.


· Ability to coordinate between technical and business departments.


· Organization and attention to detail to ensure quality in deliverables.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:


· Experience in the telecom sector or with B2B2C platforms.


· Familiarity with partner integration processes and offer configuration.


· Basic knowledge of functional testing and QA tools.


· Fluency in Spanish.



ABOUT THE COMPANY:


TIMWETECH, a Portuguese multinational, is a global provider of technology solutions, operating in 80 countries through 30 offices and serving our clients with a diverse portfolio organized into three vertical sectors: B2B2C Platform Services, Digital Marketing, and Fintech.

title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist



AdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple

programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and

maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Execute end-to-end trafficking and setup across multiple DSPs, including QA and launch

readiness.

• Manage pacing and delivery to ensure budgets and flight dates remain on track.

• Perform detailed QA across targeting, creatives, tracking, and measurement prior to launch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, tracking errors, creative rejections, and platform-level discrepancies.

• Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented

correctly and on time.

• Maintain accurate documentation, naming conventions, and operational workflows across platforms.

• Support reporting needs by ensuring campaign data is consistent and properly structured.

• Stay up to date on DSP requirements, ad operations best practices, and evolving programmatic standards.



Whats You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in ad operations, trafficking, or execution across multiple DSPs (BeesWax, Xandr, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, etc.).

• Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic

advertising.

• Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.

• Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.

• Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.



What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (dependent on region)
  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible, remote-first culture
  • Coworking space allowance
  • Gym membership reimbursement
  • Mobile phone plan reimbursement

Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

title: Especialista de Sistemas - Product Owner
description:
Atribuições:


  • Traduzir objetivos de negócio e necessidades regulatórias em roadmap, épicos, features e histórias de usuário claras e testáveis.
  • Atuar como ponte entre negócio, tecnologia, risco/compliance, operações e atendimento, garantindo alinhamento e decisões rápidas.
  • Conduzir discovery (entrevistas, dados, jornadas, hipóteses, MVPs) e delivery (priorização, refinamento, aceite, release).
  • Ser dono do backlog: priorizar com base em valor, impacto, risco, dependências e capacidade (ex.: WSJF/RICE).
  • Operar o fluxo no Jira (boards, workflows, automations, dashboards, JQL, métricas), mantendo rastreabilidade e visibilidade ponta a ponta.
  • Facilitar e sustentar rituais ágeis (planning, refinement, daily, review, retro) e promover melhoria contínua do processo do time.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs/OKRs (ativação, conversão, retenção, NPS/CSAT, fraude/chargeback, tempo de ciclo, qualidade).
  • Garantir qualidade do que é entregue: critérios de aceite, DoR/DoD, homologação com stakeholders e gestão de incidentes/bugs prioritários.
  • Requisitos desejáveis: vivência em banco digital/fintech (Pix, onboarding/KYC, cartões, crédito, antifraude), integração via APIs e sqquads multidisciplinares.


Requisitos Necessários:


  • Graduação Completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada
  • Experiência prévia como PO/PM ou em funções similares de gestão de produtos.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e liderança.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos.
  • Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.



*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are recruiting for marketing and advertising professionals for a paid consultancy session on an online research study.



Qualifications:

  • Seniority: Manager+
  • Function: Marketing / Advertising

  • Need to have some involvement in marketing and advertising spending decisions
  • The purpose of this study is to gather insights from professionals regarding digital advertising.

Compensation package - R$ 220 for 20 minutes online

title: Growth / BD Manager
description:
Role Summary:

We are looking for a results-oriented BD Manager to develop and maintain relationships with partners and identifying new business opportunities.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities with potential customers and strategic partners.
  • Collaborate with marketing, sales, and product teams to develop and execute effective sales strategies and tactics.
  • Extensive network and strong resource connections in local market (top KOLs, community leaders, etc.), with a proven track record of successful cases.
  • Have verifiable trading volume on another exchange.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify emerging trends and opportunities in the crypto exchange industry.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.Develop and deliver presentations and proposals to potential partners to showcase our products and services.


Job Requirements:

  • Candidates with background in foreign exchange trading, trading funds, and online gambling.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in business development, sales, or related field.
  • Demonstrated success in identifying and closing new business opportunities.
  • Strong knowledge of the crypto exchange industry and market trends.Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish / Portuguese.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and build relationships with a range of stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver results under tight deadlines.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


About CoinEx:

Founded in December 2017, CoinEx is a global cryptocurrency exchange under the ViaBTC Group. Available in 18 languages, CoinEx offers products and services that include spot, futures, margin trading, mining, AMM, and CoinEx Dock, providing simple, safe, and reliable crypto trading services for over 10 million users in 200+ countries and regions.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Marketing Operations Analyst
description:
Estamos contratando | Analista de Trade Marketing & Expansão Varejo | São Paulo


A Avlon Brasil está crescendo e buscamos um(a) profissional para integrar nosso time de operações comerciais e marketing.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Executar e monitorar estratégias de trade marketing no canal profissional (salões, distribuidores e varejo)
  • Apoiar o processo de abertura e estruturação de lojas físicas — do planejamento à execução no PDV
  • Desenvolver e coordenar materiais de merchandising, campanhas e ações promocionais
  • Interagir com as áreas comercial e de marketing para identificar oportunidades por canal
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e propor planos de ação

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência em trade marketing, preferencialmente no segmento de beleza ou bens de consumo
  • Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de transitar entre estratégia e execução
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar com múltiplas áreas
  • Organização e senso de dono

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em processos de abertura de pontos de venda ou expansão de varejo
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e e-commerce (não obrigatório, mas bem-vindo)

São Paulo | Regime: PJ

title: SAP SD Techno Functional Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Role Overview

The SAP SD Techno‑Functional Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, and delivering SAP Sales & Distribution solutions, along with managing technical enhancements through ABAP knowledge. The role bridges functional expertise with technical capability to support end‑to‑end sales process.


Key Responsibilities


Functional Responsibilities

  • Gather and analyze business requirements related to Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Sales & Distribution processes.
  • Configure SAP SD modules including:
  • Customer Master, Material Master, Pricing, Output Determination
  • Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing
  • Shipping, Credit Management, Returns & Refunds
  • Availability Check (ATP), Intercompany sales, Third‑party sales
  • Design and implement pricing procedures, tax configurations, and condition techniques.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (MM, FI, PP, WM, CRM, TM).
  • Provide support for UAT, SIT, integration testing, and Go-Live.
  • Prepare functional specifications for RICEFW objects.


Technical Responsibilities (Techno‑Functional)

  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to build and enhance custom objects.
  • Ability to debug ABAP code to perform issue analysis.
  • Create Functional Design Documents (FDD), and review Technical Design Documents (TDD).


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.

title: Analista de Testes / QA Sênior
description:
Analista de Testes / QA Sênior


Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para Analista de Testes/QA Sênior experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


Perfil técnico:

  • Sólida experiência em automação de testes e testes não-funcionais;
  • Criação de Plano de teste;
  • Criação e execução dos cenários e casos de teste;
  • Conhecimento em C#
  • Experiência com validação de APIs REST
  • Experiência com ferramentas para registro dos cenários e acompanhamento da execução (exemplo XRay/Jira);
  • Conhecimento em utilizar as ferramentas: Banco dados Oracle, Git, Jenkins, Jira, PL/SQL, Postman e Visual Studio;
  • Conhecimento em Specflow e NUnit


Atuação:

  • Atuar em time Scrum com foco principal em testes e qualidade de softwares;
  • Entender as necessidades do cliente e documentar em roteiros de testes;

  • Capacidade de pesquisar, identificar e implementar novas tecnologias de testes automatizados
  • Participar ativamente do processo de qualidade das soluções da companhia

title: Gerente de contas-chave
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos buscando um(a) Gestor comercial para atender ao canal de Distribuição do ramo farma, com atuação em PA - AP - AM - RR


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável pelo sellin, sellout e gestão de inventário de grupos de distribuidoras parceiras de uma região delimitada;
  • Lidera o desenvolvimento de contas regionais migradas para atendimento via distribuição;
  • Controla os investimentos para sellout para os PDVs não visitados;
  • Maximiza a venda e distribuição de todos os produtos da empresa na região atribuída através do estabelecimento e execução adequada de programas de vendas locais;
  • Responsável por alinhar todas as estratégias nacionais e regionais com os Disty;
  • Treina, desenvolve e acompanha os vendedores terceiros da distribuidora. Estar presente em campo para apoiar a equipe do distribuidor no alcance de suas metas e para acompanhar os concorrentes e a dinâmica do mercado;
  • Realizar análises dos canais de vendas, monitorar o trade e o comportamento do cliente, visando captar continuamente as tendências do mercado para identificar oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de desempenho para identificar oportunidades e gerar insights para melhoria;
  • Assegurar a gestão dos investimentos da área comercial e acompanhar os KPIs financeiros;
  • Monitora a atividade do mercado / varejista para desenvolver as estratégias mais econômicas a fim de impulsionar o volume e a lucratividade por meio de maior penetração e giro;
  • Executa as rotinas desenhadas no programa de excelência (PEX).


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo (engenharias, economia, física, estatísticas, matemática, adm);
  • Experiência como Key Account Manager (Desejável);
  • Desejável experiência com disty semi-exclusivo ou exclusivo no segmento de (higiene e beleza, consumo alimentar ou bebidas);
  • Excel avançado (mandatório);
  • Capacidade analítica e qualidade de decisão (PDCA);
  • Liderança indireta (lidera indiretamente dos RCAs do Disty);
  • Gerencia o conflito;
  • Conhecimento de JBP (Joint Bussines Plan) c/ ScoreCard;
  • Foco em resultados com diligência.·


Informações adicionais

  • Vale refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Auxílio medicamentos.
  • Total Pass
